# Mapps Creation

> Wholesale trader and distributor of Lycra, knitted and polyester-lycra fabrics for garment manufacturers and exporters across India, based in Surat, Gujarat.

## Pages
- [Home](https://mappscreation.com/): Overview of Mapps Creation's fabric supply, sourcing model and how to order.
- [About](https://mappscreation.com/about): Company background, founder Pratham Aggarwal, and sourcing/quality process in Surat.
- [Fabric Catalogue](https://mappscreation.com/catalogue): Browsable catalogue of Lycra, knitted, polyester-lycra, melange, twill and matty fabrics with indicative rates.
- [Wholesale Partner Program](https://mappscreation.com/wholesale): How to register as a wholesale buyer, order process and dispatch terms.
- [Contact](https://mappscreation.com/contact): WhatsApp, phone and enquiry form for fabric requirements.
- [FAQ](https://mappscreation.com/faq): Answers on MOQ, pricing, payment, GST billing, and dispatch coverage.

## Optional
- [Privacy Policy](https://mappscreation.com/privacy): How enquiry-form and WhatsApp data is collected and used.
